name: Symmetric Matrix Stripping
definition: Extracts the 6 unique elements from the lower triangular part of a batch of 3x3 symmetric matrices (covariance matrices) into a flat tensor of shape `(N, 6)`.
summary: Symmetric Matrix Stripping extracts the six unique lower-triangular elements from batched 3x3 symmetric matrices into a flat tensor, reducing storage by eliminating redundant upper-triangular data.
